p: Goodson and Demercado will keep competing for the active RB spot until the team is healthier.
Both backs are low-volume, committee-style options in a run game that got going.
we'll let both those guys compete.
Goodson will serve as a change-of-pace RB who can be active because of his special teams value.
He is a depth piece, not a clear fantasy starter, and will help rebuild a room that lost Malik.
number one's got some speed, some juice, some change of pace ability.
